name: World Heritage Sites
definition: A site inscribed on UNESCO's World Heritage List.

name: Art Museums
definition: A museum or gallery a traveller visits for its art.

name: Public Art & Monuments
definition: An outdoor sculpture, statue, monument, memorial, fountain or arch, made to be looked at or to commemorate.

name: Places of worship
definition: A place people go to worship, pray or make a pilgrimage, of any faith, and that a traveller visits: a church, a mosque, a temple, a synagogue, a gurdwara, a monastery, a dervish lodge; a saint's tomb or shrine people pray at, such as a dargah or an imamzadeh; a terreiro; a state altar; a holy spring, grove, lake or mountain where the place itself is what is venerated.

name: Archaeology
definition: The remains of a past settlement, sanctuary or monument that a traveller stands in, excavated or standing in ruin, or a museum of what was found there.

name: Notable works
definition: One artwork or artefact shown inside a venue: a painting, a sculpture, a find, a relic, or a part of the building itself that is singled out, such as a mosaic, a cycle of wall paintings or a decorated room.

name: History museums
definition: A museum of a country, a city, a people, a war or a person, visited for what it tells rather than for art or finds.

name: Science & nature museums
definition: A museum of natural history, science, technology, transport or the sea.

name: Specialty museums
definition: A museum of one kind of object, one trade or one art other than painting and sculpture, visited for the curiosity of the collection: dolls, stamps, cameras, toys, musical instruments.

name: Towers & landmarks
definition: A structure built for use and visited as a sight: a tower, a minaret, a gate, a city or frontier wall, a staircase, a stepwell, a cistern, a lighthouse.

name: Architecture
definition: A building visited for the building itself: a house, a hall, a station, a library building, a modern landmark.

name: Palaces & castles
definition: A palace, castle, fortress, citadel or imperial villa visited as a sight.

name: Historic houses
definition: A historic house, mansion or homestead opened to visitors for how people lived in it, furnished or not.

name: Bridges & engineering marvels
definition: A bridge, tunnel, dam, canal or aqueduct visited as a sight.

name: Squares & streets
definition: A square, a street or a promenade a visitor walks through as a sight in itself.

name: Neighbourhoods & districts
definition: A quarter of a city with an identity of its own, visited for its streets and life rather than for one sight.

name: Towns & villages
definition: A town or village visited as a destination in itself, often as a day trip.

name: Markets
definition: A market, bazaar, food hall, shopping arcade or craft centre a visitor browses or shops in.

name: Shops
definition: A single shop a visitor goes to for what it sells or for the shop itself: a confectioner, a coffee roaster, a perfumer, a textile house, a bookshop.

name: Parks & gardens
definition: A city park, a botanical garden, a historic or palace garden, or a grove kept for walking in.

name: Natural landmarks
definition: A natural feature visited as a sight: a mountain, volcano, island, lake, river, gorge, waterfall, cave, canyon, bay, rock formation, desert, dune field, salt flat, reef, atoll, sandbank or mangrove.

name: Cultural landscapes
definition: A landscape people shaped and still work: terraces, salt pans, canals, rice fields.

name: National parks & reserves
definition: A national park, a nature reserve or a protected landscape a visitor enters to be in nature.

name: Beaches & swimming spots
definition: A beach, a swimming hole or a sea pool.

name: Baths & spas
definition: A place visited to bathe or be treated the way the region does, or for the bathhouse as a building: a hamam, a banya, a sento, an onsen, a hot-spring pool, a spa.

name: Viewpoints & panoramas
definition: A place visited for the view from it: a lookout, a hill, a terrace.

name: Zoos & aquariums
definition: A zoo, an aquarium, a wildlife park or an animal sanctuary.

name: Theme & amusement parks
definition: An amusement park, a theme park, a film-studio park or a living-history park.

name: Entertainment venues
definition: A theatre, opera house, concert hall or historic cinema visited for the house or for a night in it.

name: Live music venues
definition: A club, dance hall, cabaret, music bar or house of traditional music a visitor goes to for live music or to dance on an ordinary night: a casa de la música, an mbalax club, an azmari bet, a jazz club.

name: Sports venues
definition: A stadium, an arena or a ground visited for a match or for the place itself.

name: Historic hotels, cafes & restaurants
definition: A cafe, restaurant, bar, sweet shop, street stall or hotel that is itself the reason to go.

name: Wineries & vineyards
definition: A winery, a vineyard or a wine district visited for tasting, as distinct from any other farm or workshop of the region.

name: Farms & workshops
definition: A working farm, plantation, estate, distillery, brewery, factory or workshop a visitor is shown round to see how a product of the region is grown or made: a spice farm, a tea estate, a cigar factory, a brandy distillery, a carpet workshop.

name: Cemeteries
definition: A cemetery or burial ground of many graves that is visited for its graves and monuments and is not known only from excavation.

name: Historical sites
definition: A place where a significant moment happened, visited for that moment.

name: Famous people's places
definition: The house, studio or grave of a notable person.

name: Universities & libraries
definition: A university or a library open to visitors.

name: Madrasas & historic colleges
definition: A historic place of learning visited as a monument, whether or not it still teaches: a madrasa, an imperial academy, a medieval college.

name: Observatories & planetariums
definition: An observatory, a planetarium or a dark-sky site.

name: Street art & murals
definition: A street, a wall or a district known for its street art.

name: Regional food
definition: A dish or a food product of the region that a visitor should try.

name: Regional drinks
definition: A drink with a regional identity: a wine, a spirit, a beer, a tea, a coffee, a soft drink.

name: Food experiences
definition: A culinary thing to take part in: a cooking class, a tasting, a tea ceremony, a street-food round.

name: Festivals & events
definition: A recurring festival, celebration, fair, religious feast or sporting event, whatever calendar sets its day.

name: Seasonal phenomena
definition: A natural event tied to a time of year: blossom, autumn colour, a migration, an aurora.

name: Hiking trails & walks
definition: A walking route: a trek, a coastal walk, a city walk with a known start and end.

name: Day trips & itineraries
definition: A day trip or an itinerary that links several places into one outing.

name: Iconic transport
definition: A ride that is itself the experience: a historic tram, a ferry, a cable car, a scenic train, a vintage car, a rickshaw, a shared minibus.

name: Outdoor activities
definition: Something active to do outdoors: rafting, surfing, kayaking, diving, climbing a rock, riding, a balloon flight.

name: On-site activities
definition: Something a visitor does at one place as part of visiting it and that guides single out: climbing its dome, tower or minaret, going inside a pyramid, a tour of the house, a walk on its roof or wall.

name: Wellness
definition: A treatment or practice for body and mind taken where it belongs: a massage, a spa ritual, a yoga class, a meditation retreat.

name: Tours & cruises
definition: A guided tour, a boat trip or a cruise taken as an outing.

name: Wildlife encounters
definition: Watching or meeting animals where they live: whale watching, a bird colony, feeding deer.

name: Shows & performances
definition: A staged show or performance a visitor attends on any ordinary evening.

name: Intangible heritage
definition: A living tradition a visitor can watch or take part in: a craft, a performing art, a ritual.

name: Local customs
definition: An everyday habit of the place a visitor joins: the coffeehouse or the coffee bench in the street, the public bath, the evening stroll, the board game on the pavement.

name: Traditional stays
definition: A way of lodging that is itself the experience: a ryokan, a casa particular, a riad, a houseboat.

name: Regional sports & games
definition: A sport to watch or join where it belongs: a traditional game, or a match of the sport the place lives for.

name: Books
definition: A book set in the region.

name: Films
definition: A film set in or shot in the region.

name: Podcasts
definition: A podcast about or from the region.

name: Music
definition: A musician or a band from the region.

name: Notable people
definition: A famous person born in or tied to the region.

name: Wildlife
definition: A species a visitor can observe in the region, with its season.

name: Lazarus species
definition: A species thought extinct and found again.

name: Coins
definition: A coin in circulation in the region.

name: Soundscapes
definition: The ambient sound of a place.
